title: Nettrace: fix timestamps, remove milliseconds increment
description: This change makes 3GPP Nettrace timestamps behavior the same as in Wireshark 2.x. Currently both seconds and nanoseconds are accumulated, which is unnecessary and also makes nanoseconds to overrun the int and affect time display of subsequent packets. With this fix, nanoseconds are written 'as is', without increment, only the seconds are incremented.
